# llms.txt for Painters of Geelong

# Painters of Geelong

> Painters of Geelong is a local, owner-operated house and commercial painting company based in Armstrong Creek, Victoria, with 25+ years of experience serving Geelong and surrounding suburbs. Services span interior and exterior house painting, commercial painting, deck and timber staining, and surface preparation/pressure cleaning, backed by Dulux premium paints, a 10-year workmanship warranty, free itemised quotes, and 5-star reviews on hipages.

## Entity Attributes
- **Business Name:** Painters of Geelong
- **Years of Experience:** 25+ years
- **Business Type:** Local, owner-operated house and commercial painting company
- **Paint Supplier:** Dulux (premium paints)
- **Warranty:** 10-year workmanship warranty
- **Customers Served:** 300+ satisfied customers across the Geelong region
- **Satisfaction Rate:** 100% satisfaction guaranteed (as stated on-site)
- **Reviews:** 5-star rated on hipages
- **Phone:** 0431 261 281
- **Email:** Paintersofgeelong@outlook.com
- **Address:** Armstrong Creek, VIC 3217
- **Working Hours:** Monday to Saturday, 7am–7pm; closed Sunday

## Core Services
- [Interior House Painting](https://www.paintersofgeelong.com.au/services/interior-house-painters.html): Interior painting covering walls, ceilings, doors and trims, feature walls, and apartment painting. Pricing: full 3-bedroom interior repaint $5,000–$9,500; single rooms from ~$400; apartments from $2,500 (1-bedroom $2,500–$4,000, 2-bedroom $3,500–$5,500). Typical turnaround 2–5 days.
- [Exterior House Painting](https://www.paintersofgeelong.com.au/services/exterior-house-painters.html): Exterior painting covering weatherboard, brick, fences, garage doors and trims, and outdoor facades, using weather-resistant paint systems. Pricing: full single-storey exterior repaint $7,000–$14,000. Typical turnaround 5–9 days.
- [Commercial Painting](https://www.paintersofgeelong.com.au/services/commercial-building-painters.html): Commercial painting for offices, shops and retail stores, warehouses, restaurants and cafés, and strata/property management, completed with minimal disruption to business operations.
- [Deck & Timber Staining](https://www.paintersofgeelong.com.au/services/deck-and-timber-staining.html): Deck staining, timber sealing, pergola painting, fence staining, and timber restoration for outdoor timber surfaces.
- [Surface Prep & Pressure Cleaning](https://www.paintersofgeelong.com.au/services/pressure-washing-surface-prep.html): Pressure washing, surface cleaning, sanding and priming, crack and hole filling, and minor repairs/patching as standalone or pre-painting preparation services.
